Constitution of a private limited liability company named 'C.C.I.' with its registered office in Ixelles. The company's object includes wholesale and retail trade, import/export, leasing of rolling stock, fuels, oils, and parts; operation of driving schools; breakdown service; acquisition and management of movable and immovable property. Capital is 750,000 francs. Management is entrusted to one or more managers. Alain Flamme is appointed as the manager. A special mandate is conferred to Jacques Stichelbaut for fiscal and VAT administrations. Filed in Brussels on 6 novembre 1997 (A/873).
